name: filter-search
title: Filter Search
description: The search box of a filter schema: shows the text at once and commits it after the page controller's 250 ms debounce, Enter commits, Escape clears. FilterScope gives filter UIs their schema and controller and lets agents filter by a field's label.
docs: Inside a `ServerDataTable` (its `toolbar`, or `filterUi="search"`) it finds the schema and controller by itself; elsewhere wrap filter UIs in `<FilterScope schema controller label>` or pass `schema` and `controller`. It edits the schema's first text field and takes its `label` as its name unless you pass one; its placeholder is `placeholder`, or the scope's `searchPlaceholder` (a `ServerDataTable` sets "Search {label}…"). An agent's `setValue` commits without the debounce. `FilterScope` is a group named by `label` with agent actions `filter(field, value)`, where the field is a key or a label and the value loose input (option labels or values, `"yes"`, `">= 10"`, `"2026-01-01..2026-01-31"`, read by `parseFilterInput`), and `clearFilters()`. `useFilterScope(props)` returns the schema, controller and state for a filter UI of your own.
